mentions.name: Curlime
mentions.description: This tool uses AI to generate deterministic text transformations that can be saved and reused later, avoiding repeated LLM-call costs and hallucinations. Generated transformation code is executed safely in a local lightweight VM, providing a simple way to generate, save, and run text transformations without hand-writing code or wrestling with regex.
mentions.problem: Cleaning up text with non-trivial requirements takes considerable time to figure out using a normal text editor's find-and-replace and regex, and re-running LLM calls for the same transformations adds cost and hallucination risk.
mentions.source_excerpt: The idea is to have deterministic text transformations generated by AI, which can be saved and reused later to avoid incurring/piling up LLM-call cost and hallucinations.

evidence.value: The idea is to have deterministic text transformations generated by AI, which can be saved and reused later to avoid incurring/piling up LLM-call cost and hallucinations.
